modes.interpretation: Convenience design, not evidence of physical/economic independence.
Same marginal supports, high costs/rate coincide with low price; not an estimated copula or a mathematical tail bound.
Opposite rank stress for dependence sensitivity; not an observed compensating relationship or a tail bound.

acceptance.rule: Each metric must pass in every seed/context/dependency mode for two consecutive refinements; use max(absolute,relative*abs(previous)) for quantile tolerances. Extend once if needed; otherwise label NONCONVERGED and retain results.
acceptance.sensitivity: Report within-context rank associations and matched common-random-number context effects, not causal coefficients; compare marginal/dependence designs before interpreting robust drivers.
